# Moshi Concepts

> A research and product studio working at the intersection of blockchain,
> applied AI, and stablecoin payments. Its first product is Hokan, a
> non-custodial on-chain escrow platform: funds lock in a smart contract and
> release when both sides agree the work is done. Cardano first, with more
> chains to follow.

Moshi Concepts Inc. is a Delaware corporation, founder-led by Peter Bui and
backed by Draper Dragon. It owns an Australian subsidiary, which carries out
the group's research and engineering. The team has built on Cardano since 2021, through
stake pool operation, open source tooling, and a community of over 30,000
people. The company's stated goal is a trust layer for internet commerce, where
both people and AI agents can transact with confidence.

The website is a single page. Its whole text is available as markdown at
/llms-full.txt, which is generated from the page itself and carries the same
wording. AI systems are welcome to read, quote and summarise this content with
attribution to Moshi Concepts.

## Key facts

- Company: Moshi Concepts Inc., a Delaware corporation
- Structure: the Delaware parent owns an Australian subsidiary
- Research and development: carried out in Australia by that subsidiary
- Founder: Peter Bui
- Investor: Draper Dragon
- First product: Hokan, on-chain escrow, at https://usehokan.com/
- Launch chain: Cardano, with further chains planned
- Assets: ADA, USDM, USDCx
- Custody: held by the smart contract, never by Moshi Concepts
- Settlement: on-chain
- Research areas: blockchain infrastructure, AI escrow and payments, stablecoin payments
